description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans grain activation and lifecycle behaviors, including key handling, error scenarios, and request context propagation.

classes.name: BasicActivationTests
classes.description: A test class verifying Orleans grain activation, key handling, error scenarios, and request context propagation.

methods.name: GetResponseTimeout
methods.description: Retrieves the current response timeout setting from the Orleans client.

methods.name: SetResponseTimeout
methods.description: Sets the response timeout for the Orleans client.

methods.name: BasicActivation_ActivateAndUpdate
methods.description: Tests activation and state persistence for grains with long integer keys.

methods.name: BasicActivation_Guid_ActivateAndUpdate
methods.description: Tests activation and state persistence for grains with Guid keys.

methods.name: BasicActivation_Fail
methods.description: Verifies error handling when grain activation fails due to invalid key.

methods.name: BasicActivation_BurstFail
methods.description: Tests handling of multiple concurrent activation failures.

methods.name: BasicActivation_ULong_MaxValue
methods.description: Tests grain activation with ulong.MaxValue cast to long.

methods.name: BasicActivation_Long_MaxValue
methods.description: Tests grain activation with int.MaxValue as key.

methods.name: BasicActivation_Long_MinValue
methods.description: Tests grain activation with long.MinValue as key.

methods.name: BasicActivation_MultipleGrainInterfaces
methods.description: Verifies grains implementing multiple interfaces and returning references.

methods.name: BasicActivation_Reentrant_RecoveryAfterExpiredMessage
methods.description: Tests recovery after message timeout in reentrant grains.

methods.name: BasicActivation_TestRequestContext
methods.description: Verifies request context propagation from client to grain.
